messages:
Marta Garcia: Hey team — scheduling onsite for Candidate Alex M. on Wed May 14 (PT). Full day 9:00am–3:00pm PT. Need panel availability, confirm travel stipend, badge request, and any accessibility/dietary needs. Zoom fallback if anything pops.

Kevin Wu: I can do 9:30–11:00 PT (onsite panel). happy to take infra slot.

Leda (Recruiter): Alex prefers early flights, needs vegan lunch, wheelchair access, and will need a loaner MacBook for the onsite coding exercise. Also has a question about visa sponsorship timeline (non-US work auth).

Marta Garcia: Noted. People Ops will handle badge + accessibility. Can someone from infra confirm loaner availability? TAG: inventory L-322 exists but may be in use. @Kevin do you have a spare?

Kevin Wu: I don't have an extra company Mac available. I can bring my personal laptop wiped & imaged if we prefer, but Ops-provided loaner is better for audit.

People Ops Bot: Badge request submitted — req#PR-7784. Expected ready Thu 10:00am. Visitor parking permit hold for 'Alex M.' placed.

Leda (Recruiter): Travel stipend: domestic up to $500, expense code EXP-HIRE-2025. Candidate prefers ACH reimbursement; will send bank details after offer. Dietary confirmed: vegan.

Marta Garcia: OK — please have candidate email receipts to hiring-expenses@redwood.com. I'll DM Payroll for ACH pre-setup. For visa question, loop in Legal: legal@redwood.com and ask for a quick 1:1.

Kevin Wu: Panel confirmed from my side: Kevin, Jana, Omar. Can we schedule a 45m slot for 'infrastructure deep-dive' at 10:15?

Marta Garcia: Put on calendar: 10:15–11:00 'Infra deep-dive' (45m). Onsite location: Building A, 5th floor, Room 512. Zoom fallback link included on the event. I'll add notes: "Bring gov ID for front desk; leave license at reception for visitor permit."

Leda (Recruiter): Candidate flight lands SFO 8:20am, taxi booked. Onsite parking: we reserved visitor permit. Candidate will check in at front desk and present gov ID.

Marta Garcia: Quick security/inventory instructions for the loaner if we provide one:
```
- Loaner tag: L-322
- Wipe & image: use img-std-2025
- Install exam env: /opt/hiring/exam-setup.sh
- Sign loaner form: ops/loaner-form.pdf
```

Marta Garcia: Action items: (1) Ops to confirm loaner availability (2) Payroll to enable ACH for candidate (3) Legal to answer visa question (4) Recruiter to confirm arrival ETA & receipts flow. Please react with :thumbsup: when done.

Kevin Wu: I can pick up loaner from ops if available. :thumbsup:

People Ops Bot: Reminder created: pickup reminder Tue 4:00pm for loaner L-322.

Leda (Recruiter): Thanks all — I'll send final candidate itinerary + contact number by EOD.
